issue_title: Empty Data messages can collide with chunked encoding end-of-message
issue_body: Chunked encoding indicates end-of-message by sending an empty chunk: 0\r\n\r\n. h11 currently encodes Data(data=b\"\") the same way, so an empty Data event collides with EndOfMessage. Fix empty Data for chunked encoding so it emits no bytes, while EndOfMessage still emits the terminator.
validation_patch:
diff --git a/h11/tests/test_io.py b/h11/tests/test_io.py
--- a/h11/tests/test_io.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_io.py
@@ -332,6 +332,8 @@
 def test_ChunkedWriter():
     w = ChunkedWriter()
     assert dowrite(w, Data(data=b"aaa")) == b"3\r\naaa\r\n"
     assert dowrite(w, Data(data=b"a" * 20)) == b"14\r\n" + b"a" * 20 + b"\r\n"
 
+    assert dowrite(w, Data(data=b"")) == b""
+
     assert dowrite(w, EndOfMessage()) == b"0\r\n\r\n"

issue_body: Passing h11.Response(status_code=HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND) should preserve the numeric HTTP status code. The current implementation accepts IntEnum because it is an int subclass, but string formatting later can produce the enum name instead of 404. Normalize accepted status codes to actual int values.
validation_patch:
diff --git a/h11/tests/test_events.py b/h11/tests/test_events.py
--- a/h11/tests/test_events.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_events.py
@@ -134,3 +134,16 @@
 
     cc = ConnectionClosed()
     assert repr(cc) == "ConnectionClosed()"
+
+
+def test_intenum_status_code():
+    # https://github.com/python-hyper/h11/issues/72
+    try:
+        from http import HTTPStatus
+    except ImportError:
+        pytest.skip("Only affects Python 3")
+
+    r = Response(status_code=HTTPStatus.OK, headers=[], http_version="1.0")
+    assert r.status_code == HTTPStatus.OK
+    assert type(r.status_code) is not type(HTTPStatus.OK)
+    assert type(r.status_code) is int

issue_title: Handle multiple Content-Length headers with the same value
issue_body: RFC 7230 allows a recipient to normalize duplicate Content-Length fields when every decimal value is identical. h11 currently rejects multiple Content-Length headers even when they have the same value. Accept duplicate equal values and comma-separated equal values by normalizing them to one header, but continue rejecting conflicting values.
validation_patch:
diff --git a/h11/tests/test_headers.py b/h11/tests/test_headers.py
--- a/h11/tests/test_headers.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_headers.py
@@ -54,6 +54,18 @@
     with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
         normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "2")])
+    assert normalize_and_validate(
+        [("Content-Length", "0"), ("Content-Length", "0")]
+    ) == [(b"content-length", b"0")]
+    assert normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "0 , 0")]) == [
+        (b"content-length", b"0")
+    ]
+    with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
+        normalize_and_validate(
+            [("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "2")]
+        )
+    with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
+        normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "1 , 1,2")])
